positive_controls.description: Every OLD_verbatim string in the authority amendment's SECTION_A1_DEFECT_ADJUDICATION.DEFECTIVE_CLAUSES (DC-1 through DC-4) is byte-identical to the string at its stated locus in the frozen parent authority at blob 154c3d1d396784ae7189b8088669b0ef8231de67, and the OLD_verbatim quoted in SECTION_A6_OF_3_CLARIFICATION is byte-identical to OPEN_FINDINGS[OF-3].finding and .disposition at the same blob. A mismatch means the amendment is citing a clause that does not exist as quoted, which voids the correction it claims to make.

The authority amendment's SECTION_A7_F_IC_3_RESTORE_PROOF_CLARIFICATION.explicit_mapping accounts for every additional RESTORE_PROOF content item the base authority requires (container identity, engine versions, PRI-7's storage-byte declaration, the governed-erasure question), and each is mapped to exactly one of the five frozen fields in docs/ops/release/STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json EVIDENCE_PACKETS.packets[RESTORE_PROOF].contents, with no item left unmapped and no field invented beyond those five.

negative_controls.description: REFUSAL: the authority amendment adds no operation to AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS (no AO-10 or any other new id appears anywhere in the amendment pair), does not weaken EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS' prohibition on triggering a restore by any mechanism, and does not weaken CAPABILITY.MANAGEMENT_PLANE.must_not's prohibition on using the management-plane token to restore a backup. Confirming that `backups restore` EXISTS in the tool must not be read, anywhere in this pair, as authorizing its use.

REFUSAL: neither PC-17 nor NC-7 nor NC-10 of the base manifest is listed among the superseded or defective clauses anywhere in the authority amendment or this manifest amendment. SECTION_A8 of the authority amendment explicitly states PC-17 and NC-7 remain true of the original authoring lane's own scope, and SECTION_A7 explicitly states NC-10 required no supersession.

REFUSAL: no numeric RPO or RTO value is declared or proposed anywhere in the amendment pair, and the RESTORE_PROOF field-mapping clarification (SECTION_A7) does not advance ENV-07's binding deadline, does not require Auth or Storage evidence for D1/S8, and does not cause D1 or S8 to inherit any ENV-07 scope. mutation_controls.description: If SECTION_A2.MEASURED_RESTORE_SURFACE.result.restore_destination_flag were altered from 'NONE' to claim a destination flag exists, or if the two measured flags (--project-ref, --timestamp) were altered to add a third, the amendment's central claim -- that CLI restore is CONFIRMED in-place -- would no longer follow from its own stated evidence. A certifier must reproduce the exact two-flag surface by running `supabase backups restore --help` at the pinned version 2.109.1 and observe the mismatch if this mutation were applied.

If SECTION_A7's explicit_mapping array were deleted from the authority amendment while NC-10 of the base manifest were left as originally written ('no field added, removed or reordered'), a reader comparing NC-10 against the authority's own RESTORE_PROOF-adjacent requirements (container identity, engine version, PRI-7, the governed-erasure statement) would again see the apparent contradiction F-IC-3 identified, because nothing would explain how those four items fit inside the five frozen fields. Deletion must be detectable by re-reading NC-10 alongside the base authority's H, EVIDENCE and POST_RESTORE_INVARIANTS blocks without SECTION_A7's mapping present.
